DEAL SUMMARY MEMORANDUM
STRICTLY PRIVATE & CONFIDENTIAL

Project: MONSOON
Prepared for: Investment Committee
Date: 3 February 2025
Advisor: M/s Trilegal (India) and Allen & Gledhill LLP (Singapore)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
1. TRANSACTION OVERVIEW
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Gulf Sovereign Capital LLC ("GSC"), a sovereign wealth fund registered in
Abu Dhabi, UAE, proposes to invest USD 85,000,000 (United States Dollars
Eighty-Five Million) in TechAgri Solutions Private Limited ("Company"), an
agri-tech company headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

The investment will be structured as a primary equity infusion in exchange for
a 34% stake in the Company on a fully diluted basis, via a Singapore-incorporated
special purpose vehicle ("Singapore SPV") to access the India-Singapore
Bilateral Investment Treaty (DTAA) and treaty protection provisions.

SECTOR: Agricultural Technology / Precision Farming
STAGE: Series B (Company previously raised Series A of USD 12M in 2023)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
2. INVESTMENT STRUCTURE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Proposed Structure (Primary):

  Gulf Sovereign Capital LLC (Abu Dhabi, UAE)
    │
    ├─ Equity contribution: USD 85,000,000
    ↓
  GSC India SPV Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) ← [NEW ENTITY to be incorporated]
    │
    ├─ FDI into India under Automatic Route
    │  (Sector: Agri-tech, 100% FDI permissible under current policy)
    ↓
  TechAgri Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (Pune, India)
    └─ Post-investment stake: 34% (fully diluted)

Rationale for Singapore Routing:
- India-Singapore DTAA provides capital gains exemption on future exit
- Singapore's robust IP holding regime for agri-tech patents
- Bilateral Investment Treaty protection for sovereign investor
- No land-border restriction applicable (UAE is not a land-border country)

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
3. REGULATORY CONSIDERATIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

3.1  FDI Policy: Agri-tech / precision farming falls under automatic route;
     Government approval not required for this transaction.

3.2  Press Note 3 (2020): Not applicable — UAE is not a land-border country
     of India. Automatic route applicable.

3.3  FEMA Compliance: Inbound FDI reporting to RBI within 30 days of receipt
     of funds (Form FC-GPR).

3.4  Companies Act §90 (SBO): GSC will hold 34% — triggers SBO disclosure.
     GSC to file Form BEN-2 within 30 days of acquisition.

3.5  Transfer Pricing: Arm's length pricing to be certified for any
     inter-company transactions between Singapore SPV and India OpCo.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
4. PROPOSED GOVERNANCE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

- GSC (via Singapore SPV) to appoint 2 directors on 7-member board
- Promoters (Sharma Family Trust) to retain 3 board seats
- 2 independent directors to be mutually agreed
- GSC veto rights over: new share issuance, debt >USD 10M, M&A, change of business
- Lock-up: 24 months from closing
- Exit: GSC targeting 5–7 year hold; expects IPO or strategic sale

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
5. VALUATION
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Pre-Money Valuation: USD 165,000,000
Post-Money Valuation: USD 250,000,000 (USD 165M + USD 85M investment)
Entry Price per Share: INR 850 (approx. USD 10.20 at 83.3 INR/USD)
